source: claude-code (viewed contact sheet 1 of 5 + computed metrics)
summary: Opens with roughly 70 seconds of speech-free, music-driven aerial and landscape montage (green valleys, a lone rider in a desert, red badlands at golden hour, snow peaks above cloud) before the presenter appears. After that the film alternates host-with-locals coverage (eagle hunters, yurt building) with insert details (eagle talons, food, feet) and re-establishing wides. The grade is a saturated teal/green push with warm skin tones. Narration is 'we/our journey' guide-voice rather than diary-voice.
hook_analysis: Visual-first cold open: a sequence of the most spectacular locations promises scale before any words; first narration ('Welcome to Kazakhstan... land of eagle hunters') lands as a thesis over the montage at ~0:21.
narrative_arc: Chaptered country portrait: city arrival (Almaty) -> cultural immersion set-pieces (eagle hunting, yurt raising, food) -> further regions. Each chapter opens on an establishing wide.
camera_and_composition: Drone aerials and long-lens landscapes for scale; handheld/gimbal medium two-shots with local guides; tight macro-like inserts (eagle talons 2:59-4:08) used as cutaways. Not observable at storyboard resolution: exact camera moves.
color_and_grade: Strong teal/cyan sky and lush green push, high saturation, warm skin protected. Reads as a deliberate 'travel-commercial' grade.
sound_and_music: Opening montage is music-only; speech gaps of 12s+ recur throughout (measured), consistent with music-led transitions between set-pieces.
what_to_borrow: Open on the 4-6 most spectacular shots with music only, then state the thesis in one line
Re-establish every new location with a wide before people
Use tight detail inserts to cover cuts in conversations
what_to_avoid_copying: The heavy teal grade on footage that was not shot for it - grade to your own footage's latitude
